About the Collection

Preserving the heritage behind the hymns

The books collected and prepared through this work aim to preserve the rich heritage of Telugu Christian hymns. They bring together the meanings of the songs, information about their poets and authors, and the historical background that helps future generations understand their significance.

More publications will be added to this library as the research and documentation work continues.
